verdict.rationale: Grok Build is a locally installed CLI agent with a public GitHub repo. Community reports confirm the source was open-sourced and that forks (including privacy forks that block x.ai auto-update) appeared quickly, and the docs say any custom model can be configured. That gives real self-hosting of the harness, but no first-party documentation describes running it fully independent of xAI services, and login is reportedly gated on an xAI subscription. Missing for 10: first-party self-hosting guide and license terms, documented fully offline or local-model operation without an xAI account, independent hands-on confirmation of a self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: curl -fsSL https://x.ai/cli/install.sh | bash   # macOS / Linux / Git Bash
Grok supports any custom model. Add it to your user-level config file, `~/.grok/config.toml`
